method: Three alternating fresh-engine sessions per artifact, same unmodified compiled runtime. Fifteen public stdio MCP calls plus one warm CLI parity query, independent file/disassembly checks and owned engine/transport cleanup. OS and vendor file caches unflushed. Private fetch observer covers only the production MCP child, records request names/byte counts without response cloning; its overhead is included. Separate CLI upstream requests were not traced.
cost_scope: Kernel cgroup v2 process-family CPU/peak incl. file cache, JVM, clients, public runtime, CLI parity and native oracle. Admission wait is separate. Outer guard/systemd manager, model usage and context for independent host/native oracles unmeasured. Payload exit counters verified while observer remains alive; vanished final whole-scope counters stay unknown.

tokenizer.scope: Offline serialization estimates. One full MCP catalog page-array, named arguments and raw replies, each once; replies contain text plus structured copies. Text-only reply tokens are reported separately. The combined estimate adds selected CLI arguments and stdout from parity validation. Actual model usage, prompts, initialization/protocol framing, client filtering/rendering/replay, shell framing, and independent native/host oracle context are unmeasured. These are validation exchanges, not a model investigation comparison.
